prompt: Write up my time for Orion Advisory this week
expected_behavior: Use activity-pull then narrative-draft, map codes, run guideline-check, and produce cited draft entries without submitting time.

prompt: Will this narrative get rejected: attention to various matters for 7.5 hours?
expected_behavior: Run guideline-check and flag prohibited terms plus block billing with guideline citations.

prompt: What am I missing this week for this engagement?
expected_behavior: Use activity-pull and guideline-check to produce missing_time_report from engagement-scoped calendar/document activity.

prompt: Map these narratives to the client task codes
expected_behavior: Run code-map after narrative-draft and cite task-phase-codes.md for each mapping.

prompt: Prepare the pre-bill exception list for the engagement manager
expected_behavior: Use exception-report after guideline-check and include rejectable entries, missing time, citations and recommended actions.
